auth.note: Angular SPA with a REST API under /rest and /api. Product search, login, /ftp, /metrics and /api-docs are reachable unauthenticated. Most challenge solutions need a session and multi-step, hash-route SPA interaction.

expected_findings.name: SQL injection auth bypass in REST login (email)
expected_findings.evidence_hint: POST {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"x"} to /rest/user/login returns a valid admin JWT (admin@juice-sh.op). JSON API, not an HTML form.

expected_findings.name: SQL injection in product search (q)
expected_findings.evidence_hint: /rest/products/search?q=test')) returns an HTML error page whose title is 'Error: SQLITE_ERROR: near ...: syntax error'.

expected_findings.name: Unauthenticated /ftp directory listing (confidential files)
expected_findings.evidence_hint: GET /ftp returns HTTP 200 with a browsable directory listing (legal.md, acquisitions.md, *.pdf, etc.).

expected_findings.name: Unauthenticated Prometheus /metrics endpoint
expected_findings.evidence_hint: GET /metrics returns HTTP 200 Prometheus exposition text (juiceshop_* counters).

expected_findings.name: Missing Content-Security-Policy (and HSTS over HTTP)
expected_findings.evidence_hint: Response sets X-Frame-Options and X-Content-Type-Options but no Content-Security-Policy.

expected_findings.name: Swagger API documentation exposed (/api-docs)
expected_findings.evidence_hint: GET /api-docs 301 -> /api-docs/ serves the Swagger UI / OpenAPI spec.

expected_findings.name: DOM XSS in SPA search (hash route #/search?q=)
expected_findings.note: Angular bypasses sanitisation for the search query rendered via innerHTML. The payload lives in the URL fragment (#/search?q=), so it never reaches the server; confirming it needs a DOM-aware oracle that drives the SPA, not query-string reflection.

expected_findings.name: Stored XSS via comment/feedback (persisted to other users)
Wildcard CORS (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *)
expected_findings.evidence_hint: Responses set Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * (without credentials); public responses are readable cross-origin.

expected_findings.name: Open redirect allowlist bypass (/redirect?to=)
expected_findings.note: /redirect?to= rejects arbitrary hosts (HTTP 406); exploitation requires embedding an allowlisted URL substring, which a generic open-redirect probe will not stumble on.

must_not_report.reason: Juice Shop does not disclose a Server or X-Powered-By version; reporting one is a false positive.
No unauthenticated OS command injection surface; a cmdi finding is a false positive.

notes: SPA + REST target. Fair unauthenticated black-box recall denominator = {js-sqli-login, js-sqli-product-search, js-ftp-exposure, js-metrics-exposure, js-missing-headers}. The DOM/stored XSS require SPA-driven, hash-route, or authenticated interaction and are tracked as required but not blackbox_detectable.
